title: GrowthBook footer
description: A deep navy footer: wordmark, a short company blurb, a row of soft grey social icons and two round outlined compliance badges on the left; five tidy link columns on the right (with an optional small violet NEW tag); a mono copyright and legal row at the foot. Phones stack it with a two-column link grid.
notes: badges are plain text in outlined circles (pass your own marks if you have them)
